subject: Content: 7 exam titles need MCM voice — generic 'Retake Practice N' names
body:
## Content Brief: Exam Titles in manifest.json

**Audited:** data/manifest.json
**Finding:** 7 of 11 exam titles use generic 'Retake Practice N' naming. These should be descriptive and in MCM voice.

### Current vs Proposed

| Current Title | Problem | Proposed Direction |
|--------------|---------|-------------------|
| Retake Practice 1 | Generic | e.g., 'Retake: Equations Foundations' or similar based on actual Q content |
| Retake Practice 2 | Generic | e.g., 'Retake: Functions & Relations' |
| Retake Practice 3 | Generic | Needs content-based name |
| Retake Practice 4 | Generic | Needs content-based name |
| Retake Practice 5 | Generic | Needs content-based name |
| Retake Practice 8 | Generic | Needs content-based name |
| Retake Practice 9 | Generic | Needs content-based name |
| Retake Practice 6 (W2.b Drill) | Better — keep pattern | Acceptable |
| Retake Practice 7 (Mock Retake) | Better — keep pattern | Acceptable |
| Retake Practice 10 | Generic | Needs content-based name |
| Retake Practice 11 | Generic | Needs content-based name |

### MCM Voice Rules for Exam Titles
- Title case
- Describe the math concept, not the sequence number
- Maximum 5 words
- Emoji optional but welcome if it adds personality without noise
- Do NOT use: 'Practice 1', 'Unit 3', 'Module 4', or other generic academic labels

### Format
Update `data/manifest.json` — the `title` field for each exam.
Also update exam.html if it hardcodes any fallback titles.

### Priority
Normal — not a blocker for any current publish. But before Kai uses exams 3-9 heavily, descriptive titles will help him navigate.

### Note
RP10 and RP11 content is newest — name those after primary standard group targeted.
